conditions: Volume of the solid ball enclosed by a Euclidean sphere of radius r>0; the radius-zero degenerate ball has zero volume.
spoken_aliases: volume equals four thirds pi r cubed
v equals four thirds pi r cubed

evidence: Slice the solid ball perpendicular to an axis through its center. At axial coordinate z the disk has squared radius r^2-z^2. Integrating pi(r^2-z^2) from -r to r gives pi[r^2 z-z^3/3] at those bounds, or 4 pi r^3/3. The zero-radius limit is zero.

Reference cross-check of the standard relationship: https://openstax.org/books/prealgebra-2e/pages/c-geometric-formulas. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
